cases.description:
"Sort out my subscriptions" reads as task work or as finance work, and more than one route is defensible -- clarifying, listing tasks, or inspecting recurring commitments.
Because a check list is an AND, asserting any single route would fail a legitimate behaviour. So this case measures NON-FABRICATION under ambiguity, not routing: whatever it chooses, it must not invent subscriptions or amounts that do not exist.
